verdict.rationale: Switching built-in desktop themes is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions appearance modes, themes, or desktop-wide restyling. The cited material covers Continuity, Siri AI, Safari, window management and performance issues, none of which is about theming.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can instantly switch between multiple built-in visual themes that restyle the whole desktop
